items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy Lyons who was the entrepreneur and producer invited me to perform on that Monterey Jazz Festival and to write works for orchestra

ctx.x: We’d like to move on to the 1959 Monterey Jazz Festival and to two of your large works, El Camino Real and Sketch for Trombone and Orchestra that were presented as a part of the festival program that year.

I had heard about the Monterey Jazz Festival. Jimmy Lyons who was the entrepreneur and producer invited me to perform on that Monterey Jazz Festival and to write works for orchestra – well, jazz band, shall we say. I wrote those two works. One was El Camino Real which translated, I understand, means the king’s highway.
